examples.text_en: One idiosyncrasy of his is that he talks to himself.
examples.text_zh: 他的一个怪癖是自言自语。

examples.text_en: Every person has some idiosyncrasy of their own.
examples.text_zh: 每个人都有自己的一些特性。

examples.text_en: It was an idiotic thing to say to the teacher.
examples.text_zh: 对老师说这种话是愚蠢的。

examples.text_en: He made an idiotic decision and felt bad.
examples.text_zh: 他做了个愚蠢的决定，心里很懊悔。

examples.text_en: The idolater would not hear of any other god.
examples.text_zh: 这个偶像崇拜者不肯听任何别的神。

examples.text_en: They called him an idolater for his strong belief.
examples.text_zh: 由于他坚定的信仰，他们称他为偶像崇拜者。

examples.text_en: They would idolatrize the young singer.
examples.text_zh: 他们会盲目崇拜那位年轻歌手。

examples.text_en: People often idolatrize those they love too much.
examples.text_zh: 人们常常过分崇拜自己所爱的人。

examples.text_en: The old poem is a beautiful idyll of country life.
examples.text_zh: 这首古诗是一首优美的田园诗。

examples.text_en: They lived a quiet idyll in the small town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在这个小镇过着宁静的田园生活。

examples.text_en: It was an idyllic day by the quiet water.
examples.text_zh: 那是水边宁静悠闲的一天。

examples.text_en: The village looked idyllic in the morning light.
examples.text_zh: 清晨的光里，这个村庄看起来宁静如画。

examples.text_en: The igneous rock was formed by great heat.
examples.text_zh: 这块火成岩是由高温形成的。

examples.text_en: They studied igneous rock in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上研究火成岩。

examples.text_en: He used a small fire to ignite the wood.
examples.text_zh: 他用小火点燃木柴。

examples.text_en: A single word can ignite a whole group.
examples.text_zh: 一句话就能点燃整个群体。

examples.text_en: It was an ignoble act to leave his friend.
examples.text_zh: 抛下朋友是卑鄙的行为。

examples.text_en: They did not want to take such an ignoble path.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想走这样卑贱的道路。

examples.text_en: The team's loss was ignominious and hard to take.
examples.text_zh: 球队的失败可耻而令人难以接受。

examples.text_en: It was an ignominious end to a long war.
examples.text_zh: 这是一场漫长战争的可耻结局。

examples.text_en: He could not live with the ignominy of that day.
examples.text_zh: 他无法承受那天的耻辱。

examples.text_en: The whole town shared in his ignominy.
examples.text_zh: 全镇都分担着他的耻辱。

examples.text_en: They said the plan was illegitimate and against the law.
examples.text_zh: 他们说这个计划不合法，违反了法律。

examples.text_en: They called the whole idea illegitimate.
examples.text_zh: 他们称整个想法是不合法的。

examples.text_en: His illiberal ideas were not welcome in the group.
examples.text_zh: 他狭隘的想法在团体里不受欢迎。

examples.text_en: They called the old rules illiberal and unfair.
examples.text_zh: 他们称这些旧规矩狭隘又不公平。

examples.text_en: They were caught in an illicit deal.
examples.text_zh: 他们在一桩非法交易中被抓。

examples.text_en: The film tells of an illicit love.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影讲述了一段不正当的爱情。

examples.text_en: The illuminati were said to know many hidden things.
examples.text_zh: 据说这些先觉者知道许多隐秘的事。

examples.text_en: People told stories about the illuminati in the old days.
examples.text_zh: 古时候人们讲着关于先觉者的故事。

examples.text_en: The illumination of the room was soft and warm.
examples.text_zh: 房间的照明柔和而温暖。

examples.text_en: His words gave us new illumination on the problem.
examples.text_zh: 他的话使我们对这个问题有了新的启发。

examples.text_en: The hope of easy money is often illusive.
examples.text_zh: 轻松赚钱的希望往往是幻影。

examples.text_en: It was an illusive dream that never came true.
examples.text_zh: 那是一个从未实现的虚幻的梦。

examples.text_en: The safety they felt was illusory.
examples.text_zh: 他们感到的安全是虚幻的。

examples.text_en: He learned that fame could be illusory.
examples.text_zh: 他明白了名声可能只是错觉。

examples.text_en: He came from an illustrious old family.
examples.text_zh: 他出身于一个著名的古老家族。

examples.text_en: The school has a long and illustrious history.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校有着悠久而辉煌的历史。

examples.text_en: The poem is full of beautiful imagery.
examples.text_zh: 这首诗充满了美丽的比喻。

examples.text_en: The film used dark imagery to tell its story.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影用阴暗的意象来讲述故事。

examples.text_en: There is a clear imbalance of power between them.
examples.text_zh: 他们之间明显存在权力上的不平衡。

examples.text_en: The imbalance in the team caused many problems.
examples.text_zh: 队伍中的不平衡造成了许多问题。

examples.text_en: It was an imbecile plan that could not work.
examples.text_zh: 那是个不可能奏效的愚蠢计划。

examples.text_en: They called him an imbecile for his foolish act.
examples.text_zh: 他们因他愚蠢的行为称他为低能儿。

examples.text_en: He likes to imbibe a little water after the run.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢在跑步后喝一点水。

examples.text_en: They would imbibe good ideas from their teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他们会从老师那里吸取好的想法。

examples.text_en: The whole thing became a confusing imbroglio.
examples.text_zh: 整件事变成了一团混乱。

examples.text_en: They tried to end the imbroglio between the two groups.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法结束两个群体之间的纠葛。

examples.text_en: Young children are often imitative of their parents.
examples.text_zh: 幼儿常常模仿父母。

examples.text_en: He has an imitative way of talking.
examples.text_zh: 他有一种模仿式的说话方式。

examples.text_en: Her little room was immaculate and clean.
examples.text_zh: 她的小房间一尘不染，干干净净。

examples.text_en: He wore an immaculate white shirt.
examples.text_zh: 他穿着一件洁白无瑕的衬衫。

examples.text_en: The beauty of nature is immanent in everything.
examples.text_zh: 自然之美内在于万物之中。

examples.text_en: They believed that a power was immanent in the world.
examples.text_zh: 他们相信有一种力量内在于世界之中。

examples.text_en: These old trees have stood here since time immemorial.
examples.text_zh: 这些老树自古以来就立在这里。

examples.text_en: It is a custom from time immemorial.
examples.text_zh: 这是一个自古以来的习俗。

examples.text_en: They were lost in the immensity of the open sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们迷失在无边的大海之中。

examples.text_en: The immensity of the sky filled us with wonder.
examples.text_zh: 天空的广大让我们充满惊叹。

examples.text_en: The storm was imminent, so we went home.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雨即将来临，所以我们回家了。

examples.text_en: Everyone felt that a change was imminent.
examples.text_zh: 人人都感到变化即将来临。

examples.text_en: The old man sat immobile in his chair.
examples.text_zh: 老人坐在椅子里一动不动。

examples.text_en: The car was immobile after the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 长途旅行后那辆车动不了了。

examples.text_en: The immobility of the old car made us sad.
examples.text_zh: 那辆旧车动不了，让我们很难过。

examples.text_en: He lay in complete immobility all morning.
examples.text_zh: 他整个上午完全静止地躺着。

examples.text_en: The rain helped to immobilize the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 大雨使整个队伍动弹不得。

examples.text_en: They tried to immobilize the old machine.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法使那台旧机器停止运转。

examples.text_en: His immodesty made people feel uncomfortable.
examples.text_zh: 他的无礼让人感到不自在。

examples.text_en: They did not like the immodesty of his words.
examples.text_zh: 他们不喜欢他言语中的无礼。

examples.text_en: People once would immolate animals for their gods.
examples.text_zh: 人们曾为神灵宰杀动物献祭。

examples.text_en: They would never immolate a person.
examples.text_zh: 他们绝不会把一个人当作祭品。

examples.text_en: Good food and rest can help build immunity.
examples.text_zh: 好的食物和休息有助于增强免疫力。

examples.text_en: The doctor talked about immunity to that illness.
examples.text_zh: 医生谈到对那种病的免疫。

examples.text_en: The doctor will immunize the children tomorrow.
examples.text_zh: 医生明天会给孩子们接种疫苗。

examples.text_en: They tried to immunize the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法让全镇人获得免疫。

examples.text_en: The old king would immure his enemies in a dark room.
examples.text_zh: 老国王会把敌人监禁在暗室里。

examples.text_en: They did not want to immure the young man.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想监禁这个年轻人。

examples.text_en: The little imp ran around the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 这个小顽童在房间里到处跑。

examples.text_en: He was a happy imp who loved to play.
examples.text_zh: 他是个爱玩的快乐顽童。

examples.text_en: Lack of sleep can impair your work and health.
examples.text_zh: 睡眠不足会损害你的工作和健康。

examples.text_en: The long war would impair the whole country.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的战争会削弱整个国家。

examples.text_en: The old story tells of a man who could impale a fish.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事讲的是一个能把鱼刺穿的人。

examples.text_en: They used a long stick to impale the food.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一根长棍把食物串起来。

examples.text_en: There was an impalpable change in the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间里有一种难以察觉的变化。

examples.text_en: The fear she felt was impalpable but real.
examples.text_zh: 她感到的恐惧难以捉摸，却真实存在。

examples.text_en: The old man wanted to impart his knowledge to us.
examples.text_zh: 老人想把知识传授给我们。

examples.text_en: She tried to impart some good advice.
examples.text_zh: 她设法给予一些好的建议。

examples.text_en: A good judge must stay fair and impartial.
examples.text_zh: 好的法官必须保持公正和不偏不倚。

examples.text_en: They asked for an impartial look at the facts.
examples.text_zh: 他们要求对事实作不偏不倚的审视。

examples.text_en: The talks came to an impasse after many hours.
examples.text_zh: 会谈进行数小时后陷入了僵局。

examples.text_en: They could not find a way out of the impasse.
examples.text_zh: 他们无法找到摆脱僵局的办法。

examples.text_en: The old man seemed impassible to all our words.
examples.text_zh: 老人似乎对我们的所有话都无动于衷。

examples.text_en: She kept an impassible face through the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 整件事中她都面无感情。

examples.text_en: She gave an impassioned talk for the whole school.
examples.text_zh: 她为全校做了一场充满激情的演讲。

examples.text_en: His impassioned words moved everyone in the room.
examples.text_zh: 他充满激情的话语打动了屋里每个人。

examples.text_en: The man kept an impassive face all night.
examples.text_zh: 这人整夜面不改色。

examples.text_en: Her impassive answer told us nothing.
examples.text_zh: 她冷淡的回答什么也没告诉我们。

examples.text_en: The impecunious young man had no money at all.
examples.text_zh: 这个贫穷的年轻人一点钱也没有。

examples.text_en: They helped the impecunious family with food.
examples.text_zh: 他们用食物帮助这户贫穷人家。

examples.text_en: The old wall will impede the work for weeks.
examples.text_zh: 那面旧墙会妨碍工作好几个星期。

examples.text_en: Rain can impede the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 下雨会阻碍整个计划。

examples.text_en: The old law was an impediment to change.
examples.text_zh: 那条旧法律是变革的障碍。

examples.text_en: He had an impediment in his speech.
examples.text_zh: 他说话有障碍。

examples.text_en: The fear of loss can impel a man to act.
examples.text_zh: 对失去的恐惧会驱使一个人行动。

examples.text_en: What could impel them to take such a step?
examples.text_zh: 什么会迫使他们迈出这样一步？

examples.text_en: Dark times seemed to impend over the town.
examples.text_zh: 黑暗的时期似乎正逼近这座小镇。

examples.text_en: They felt that a war would impend.
examples.text_zh: 他们感到战争即将迫近。

examples.text_en: The old wall was dark and impenetrable.
examples.text_zh: 那面旧墙又暗又无法穿过。

examples.text_en: His words were impenetrable to most of us.
examples.text_zh: 他的话对我们大多数人来说难以理解。

examples.text_en: The impenitent man would not say he was sorry.
examples.text_zh: 这个不知悔改的人不肯说自己错了。

examples.text_en: She remained impenitent about the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 对整件事她始终毫无悔意。

examples.text_en: The long war would imperil the whole country.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的战争会危及整个国家。

examples.text_en: They did not want to imperil their own family.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想危及自己的家人。

examples.text_en: The imperious man gave orders to everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这个专横的人对每个人发号施令。

examples.text_en: She spoke in an imperious way that we disliked.
examples.text_zh: 她说话专横，我们都不喜欢。

examples.text_en: All things in life are impermanent.
examples.text_zh: 生活中的一切都不是永久的。

examples.text_en: They knew their home was impermanent.
examples.text_zh: 他们知道自己的家只是暂时的。

examples.text_en: The impermeability of the cloth kept the water out.
examples.text_zh: 这种布的不渗透性把水挡在外面。

examples.text_en: They tested the impermeability of the new wall.
examples.text_zh: 他们测试了新墙的不渗透性。

examples.text_en: The coat was impermeable to rain and wind.
examples.text_zh: 这件外套不透风雨。

examples.text_en: They used an impermeable cover for the food.
examples.text_zh: 他们用不渗透的盖子盖住食物。

examples.text_en: His letter was short and impersonal.
examples.text_zh: 他的信简短而没有个人感情。

examples.text_en: The office felt cold and impersonal to her.
examples.text_zh: 对她来说，这间办公室冷冰冰的，没有人情味。

examples.text_en: He likes to impersonate the old teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢模仿那位老教师。

examples.text_en: She can impersonate many famous people.
examples.text_zh: 她能模仿许多名人。

examples.text_en: His impersonation of the teacher made us laugh.
examples.text_zh: 他对老师的模仿让我们大笑。

examples.text_en: She gave a fine impersonation of a famous singer.
examples.text_zh: 她惟妙惟肖地模仿了一位著名歌手。

examples.text_en: His impertinence made the whole room quiet.
examples.text_zh: 他的鲁莽让整个房间安静下来。

examples.text_en: She was angry at the impertinence of the young man.
examples.text_zh: 她对那个年轻人的无礼感到生气。

examples.text_en: It was impertinent to ask such a question.
examples.text_zh: 问这样的问题很无礼。

examples.text_en: The impertinent boy would not stop talking.
examples.text_zh: 这个无礼的男孩不肯停止说话。

examples.text_en: The old man stayed imperturbable through the storm.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雨中老人始终泰然自若。

examples.text_en: She had an imperturbable manner that calmed us.
examples.text_zh: 她沉着的样子让我们平静下来。

examples.text_en: The old coat was impervious to the rain.
examples.text_zh: 这件旧外套不透雨。

examples.text_en: He seemed impervious to all our kind words.
examples.text_zh: 他似乎对我们所有善意的话都无动于衷。

examples.text_en: It was an impetuous act that he soon regretted.
examples.text_zh: 那是个轻率的举动，他很快就后悔了。

examples.text_en: The impetuous young man ran into danger.
examples.text_zh: 这个冲动的年轻人冲进了危险中。

examples.text_en: The good news gave new impetus to the team.
examples.text_zh: 这个好消息给团队带来了新的动力。

examples.text_en: The plan lost its impetus after the first week.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划在第一周之后就失去了动力。

examples.text_en: The new law will impinge on our daily work.
examples.text_zh: 新法律会影响到我们的日常工作。

examples.text_en: They did not want the war to impinge on their lives.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想战争侵扰自己的生活。

examples.text_en: They called his words impious and wrong.
examples.text_zh: 他们称他的话不敬神又错误。

examples.text_en: The impious man did not fear the old gods.
examples.text_zh: 这个不敬神的人不怕旧日的神灵。

examples.text_en: The doctor will implant a small device.
examples.text_zh: 医生会植入一个小装置。

examples.text_en: Good teachers implant a love of learning.
examples.text_zh: 好的老师会在心里植入对学习的热爱。

examples.text_en: His story was implausible and hard to believe.
examples.text_zh: 他的故事令人难以置信，难以相信。

examples.text_en: It seemed implausible that the plan could work.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划能成功似乎难以置信。

examples.text_en: The new facts could implicate the young man.
examples.text_zh: 新事实可能牵连到这个年轻人。

examples.text_en: They tried to implicate us in the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图把我们也牵连进整件事。

examples.text_en: There was an implicit warning in his words.
examples.text_zh: 他的话里有一种含蓄的警告。

examples.text_en: They had an implicit agreement between them.
examples.text_zh: 他们之间有一个默契的约定。

examples.text_en: The old building could implode at any time.
examples.text_zh: 那座旧楼随时可能内爆。

examples.text_en: They feared the whole system would implode.
examples.text_zh: 他们担心整个系统会崩溃。

examples.text_en: She would implore him to come home.
examples.text_zh: 她会恳求他回家。

examples.text_en: They implore us to help the poor family.
examples.text_zh: 他们恳求我们帮助那户穷人家。

examples.text_en: It was impolitic to say that to the group.
examples.text_zh: 对大家说那种话是失策的。

examples.text_en: His impolitic words caused many problems.
examples.text_zh: 他失策的话造成了许多问题。

examples.text_en: The result of the war was imponderable.
examples.text_zh: 战争的结果无法估量。

examples.text_en: They talked about the imponderable parts of life.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到生活中那些无法估量的部分。

examples.text_en: He would importune the old man for money.
examples.text_zh: 他会向老人强求钱财。

examples.text_en: They did not want to importune their friends.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想强求朋友。

examples.text_en: The whole thing was a clever imposture.
examples.text_zh: 整件事是一场巧妙的欺诈。

examples.text_en: They saw through his imposture at last.
examples.text_zh: 他们终于看穿了他的冒牌把戏。

examples.text_en: They talked about the impracticality of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到这个计划的不切实际。

examples.text_en: He saw the impracticality of the whole idea.
examples.text_zh: 他看出整个想法不切实际。

examples.text_en: The old woman would imprecate her enemies.
examples.text_zh: 老妇人会诅咒她的敌人。

examples.text_en: They did not like to hear him imprecate.
examples.text_zh: 他们不喜欢听他诅咒。

examples.text_en: His words were a long imprecation against the world.
examples.text_zh: 他的话是对这个世界的一长串诅咒。

examples.text_en: She said the imprecation in a low voice.
examples.text_zh: 她低声说出了那句诅咒。

examples.text_en: His answer was imprecise and hard to follow.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答不精确，很难听懂。

examples.text_en: The old map was imprecise but still useful.
examples.text_zh: 这张旧地图不精确，但仍有用。

examples.text_en: The old wall seemed impregnable to us.
examples.text_zh: 那面旧墙在我们看来无法攻取。

examples.text_en: They believed their home was impregnable.
examples.text_zh: 他们相信自己的家坚不可摧。

examples.text_en: The impresario brought many great singers to town.
examples.text_zh: 这位演出者把许多伟大的歌手带到城里。

examples.text_en: She worked as an impresario for many years.
examples.text_zh: 她做了很多年的演出主持人。

examples.text_en: Young children are impressionable and learn fast.
examples.text_zh: 幼儿易受感染，学得很快。

examples.text_en: He was an impressionable boy who loved stories.
examples.text_zh: 他是个容易受影响的男孩，喜欢故事。

examples.text_en: They will imprint the date on the old book.
examples.text_zh: 他们会在旧书上印上日期。

examples.text_en: The event left a deep imprint on her heart.
examples.text_zh: 这件事在她心里留下了深深的印记。

examples.text_en: The old king would imprison his enemies.
examples.text_zh: 老国王会把敌人监禁起来。

examples.text_en: They did not want to imprison the young man.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想监禁这个年轻人。

examples.text_en: It was improbable that the team could win.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍能赢是不大可能的。

examples.text_en: They said the whole story was improbable.
examples.text_zh: 他们说整个故事不太可信。

examples.text_en: He gave an impromptu talk at the party.
examples.text_zh: 他在聚会上做了即席讲话。

examples.text_en: The song was an impromptu, made up on the spot.
examples.text_zh: 这首歌是当场即兴编成的即兴曲。

examples.text_en: There was no impropriety in what she did.
examples.text_zh: 她的所作所为并无不当。

examples.text_en: They talked about the impropriety of his act.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到他行为的不当。

examples.text_en: An improvident man spends all his money early.
examples.text_zh: 一个无远见的人很早就把钱花光。

examples.text_en: They said the plan was improvident and wasteful.
examples.text_zh: 他们说这个计划缺乏远见又浪费。

examples.text_en: The team had to improvise when the plan failed.
examples.text_zh: 计划失败时，队伍只好即兴应对。

examples.text_en: She can improvise a song on the spot.
examples.text_zh: 她能当场即兴创作一首歌。

examples.text_en: He was a great improviser on the old piano.
examples.text_zh: 他是弹旧钢琴的出色即兴创作者。

examples.text_en: The young improviser loved to make up music.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻的即兴创作者喜欢编音乐。

examples.text_en: It was imprudent to spend all the money at once.
examples.text_zh: 把所有的钱一次花光太轻率了。

examples.text_en: They said his words were imprudent and unwise.
examples.text_zh: 他们说他说话轻率又不明智。

examples.text_en: They tried to impugn his good name.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图抨击他的好名声。

examples.text_en: No one could impugn her honest work.
examples.text_zh: 没有人能责难她诚实的工作。

examples.text_en: He felt a deep impuissance in the face of the war.
examples.text_zh: 面对战争，他深感无力。

examples.text_en: The old man's impuissance made him very sad.
examples.text_zh: 老人的无力感让他非常难过。

examples.text_en: She was impulsive and often acted too fast.
examples.text_zh: 她很冲动，常常行动太快。

examples.text_en: It was an impulsive buy that he soon regretted.
examples.text_zh: 那是一时冲动买下的东西，他很快就后悔了。
